advisory.summary: Concrete CMS is Vulnerable to Reflected XSS in Legacy Pagination
advisory.description: Concrete CMS 9.5.0 and below is vulnerable to Reflected XSS in Legacy Pagination via HTML attribute injection. Concrete\Core\Legacy\Pagination builds pagination links by raw-interpolating its $URL field into href="" (<a href="{$linkURL}" …>). Any authenticated admin or report viewer with access to `/dashboard/reports/forms/legacy` who clicks the crafted URL fires the payload in their session.

cwes.name: Improper Neutralization of Script in Attributes in a Web Page
